calledBy.value: Secretary issues notice after Committee fixes date/time/place/agenda; Chairman issues if Secretary fails
calledBy.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 99

noticeDays.note: 14 CLEAR days (day of issue and day of meeting excluded); notice to members under intimation to Federation and Registering Authority. 2026 Rule 106C-13(3)(d) says AGM notice/agenda 'in accordance with the Act and the bye-laws'.
noticeDays.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 100; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen)

noticeContent.value: Date, time, place, agenda. Statutory AGM business listed in bye-law 96: minutes of last AGM/SGMs, committee report and accounts (Form N), audit memorandum and rectification, election result if held, appointment of auditor from Deputy Registrar panel, matters needing GB sanction, official communications.
noticeContent.note: Items needing proper notice cannot be taken as 'any other business' (bye-law 96(viii))
noticeContent.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 96

timing.value: Within 6 months of financial-year end (30 Sep for a 31 Mar year end); accounts audited within 4 months. Bye-law 95 text says 'on or before 14 August or within the extended period under s.75(1)'.
timing.note: s.75(1) wording seen only in court summaries and guides; s.75(5) lets Registrar disqualify committee members up to 5 years for default (secondary). Bombay HC summary: disqualification automatic unless extension obtained from Registrar before expiry.
timing.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act 1960 s.75(1),(5) via https://lawtext.in/judgement.php?bid=59888 and https://housing.com/news/laws-pertaining-agm-housing-societies-maharashtra (secondary only); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 95

calledBy.value: Chairman, or by decision of majority of Committee; MUST be called within one month of receipt of written requisition signed by at least 1/5th of members, or from Registering Authority or the Housing Federation
calledBy.note: Requisition goes to Committee within 7 days (bye-law 98); requisitioned SGM may transact only business in the requisition. Act s.76(1) text not seen directly (a forum post quotes 1/5th).
calledBy.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 97-99; Act s.76

noticeDays.note: 5 clear days (Rule 106C-13(3)(g), 2026; bye-law 100). Bye-law 100: shorter notice allowed in emergency only if Committee unanimous, agenda and reasons communicated in writing, decision communicated in writing within 2 days.
noticeDays.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 100

noticeContent.value: Agenda confined to business in notice/requisition
noticeContent.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error)

noticeDays.note: 14 clear days mandatory. Registrar's representative must be present; meeting must be video-recorded (copy to Chairman and one to Asst/Dy Registrar); developer/contractor selection needs 51% of TOTAL members incl. those on video conference. A practitioner (FPJ, 21 Jul 2026) flags conflict between 2/3 commencement quorum and the adjourned-meeting rule.
noticeDays.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen); https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/mumbai/consumer-connect-maharashtras-new-redevelopment-rules-allow-online-sgbms-registrar-noc-no-longer-required

calledBy.value: Secretary in consultation with Chairman; Chairman if Secretary fails; Housing Federation if both fail. Special meeting on requisition of 1/3 of committee members, convened within 7 days.
calledBy.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error)

noticeDays.note: 3 clear days, stating date, time, place, business
noticeDays.confidence: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 133

frequency.value: At least once a month; emergency resolution by circulation allowed but must be placed at next meeting
frequency.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error)

quorum.note: bye-laws 115, 127; the size-to-quorum table was seen only in https://blog.ipleaders.in/election-procedure-for-housing-societies/ (secondary)

calledBy.value: Chief Promoter, within 3 months of registration; 14 clear days notice
calledBy.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error)

quorum.value: Two-thirds of total members or 20, whichever is less (any GB meeting, AGM or SGM). Redevelopment SGM: two-thirds of total members (no 20 cap).
quorum.note: Same figure in 2014 model bye-law 101 and 2026 Rule 106C-13(3)(f). Society's own registered bye-laws control; check them.
quorum.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 101

adjournedQuorum.value: No quorum required: if none within half an hour, a requisitioned meeting is DISSOLVED; any other meeting is adjourned to a later hour same day/place (if so specified in notice) or to a date not earlier than 7 and not later than 30 days, and original agenda business may be transacted whether quorum is present or not. Unfinished agenda may be postponed up to 30 days (bye-law 103).
adjournedQuorum.note: Exception flagged by a practitioner for redevelopment SGMs (2/3 quorum vs 51% rule).
adjournedQuorum.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen) Rule 106C-13(3)(e); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 102-103

ordinary.value: Simple majority of those present and voting; chair has casting vote on a tie (bye-laws 107-108). 2026 Rule 106C-13(3)(f) [second clause lettered (f) in source] says decisions 'shall be passed by a majority vote of fifty-one per cent of the total members of the society present, including those attending through video conferencing' - wording ambiguous (51% of those present vs of total).
ordinary.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 107-108

redevelopmentDeveloperSelection.value: 51% of TOTAL members of the society, including those attending by video conferencing
redevelopmentDeveloperSelection.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen) Rule 106C-13(3)(i)

rescission.value: No resolution cancelling a previous GB resolution unless 6 clear months have passed
rescission.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 110

special.note: Majorities for bye-law amendment, expulsion, removal of committee etc. were not retrieved from Act text.

noConfidenceAgainstOfficer.value: Special committee meeting presided by Registrar/officer not below Asst Registrar, on notice by 1/3 of committee; passed by 3/4 of members present with attendance of at least 2/3 (secondary description of bye-law 126). Bill 70/2018 proposed s.154B-24: 2/3 of committee members present. Conflict - verify enacted text.
noConfidenceAgainstOfficer.source: https://blog.ipleaders.in/election-procedure-for-housing-societies/ (secondary); Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified)

weightageModels.value: One member one vote regardless of flat size/area (no weighted votes). Associate member votes only in absence of the member (bye-law 107; Bill 154B-11(2): with member's prior written consent). Joint holders: first-named on share certificate if present, else next named present and not a minor (s.27(2) per forum summary; Bill 154B-11(4)). Nominal members: no vote (s.27(8)). Company/firm members vote through authorised director/partner (Bill 154B-11(6)). Veena Kumar Tandon v Neelam Bhalla (SC 2007): each admitted family member may vote (secondary).
weightageModels.note: Bye-law 106 defers to s.27(1),(2),(3),(3A). iPleaders (secondary) says the 2-year waiting period for voting rights was removed.
weightageModels.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 106-107; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified); https://indiancooperative.com/?p=21701 (secondary)

proxy.value: No proxy, power-of-attorney holder or authority-letter holder may attend or vote. Elections: 'no votes shall be allowed by proxy' (Rule 33). Bill 154B-11: every right to vote shall be exercised personally.
proxy.note: Some commentary suggests a POA holder may attend; the bye-law text says otherwise.
proxy.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 105; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) Rule 33; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified)

generalBody.note: Method (show of hands/poll) for ordinary GB resolutions not specified in the bye-laws or rules text seen.

committeeElection.value: Secret ballot or Electronic Voting Machine (Election Rules r.33); model bye-law 116(a): secret ballot if paid-up share capital exceeds Rs 10,000. Tie: lots drawn before Returning Officer (r.63(1) proviso).
committeeElection.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) rules 33, 63; 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 116

allowed.note: Scope: MEETING PARTICIPATION. Members may attend GB meetings in person or by video conferencing/other audio-visual means provided by the society, capable of recording and recognising participation and storing proceedings with date and time; VC attendees count toward the 51% rule. Remote e-VOTING mechanics are not expressly regulated in text seen.
allowed.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen) Rule 106C-13(3)(b) proviso

elections.note: Election Rules r.39 allows EVMs at a polling station with procedure specified by SCEA; online remote voting for committee elections not found in any primary text. Vendor blogs (right2vote.in) claim legal recognition - promotional, unverified.
elections.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) rule 39

history.value: Circular dated 25 Feb 2021 (COVID) validated online AGMs via VC/OAVM for housing societies and extended AGM deadline; notice 15 days incl. SMS/email/WhatsApp and newspaper advertisement. Temporary; current status unknown.
history.note: Seen only via ADDA blog summary; circular itself not read

minutesDeadlineDays.note: Committee finalises DRAFT minutes within 3 months of meeting; circulates within 15 days of the committee meeting that finalised them; members comment within 15 days; final minutes recorded at subsequent committee meeting. No hard statutory deadline for signed minutes found.
minutesDeadlineDays.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 109

recordRetentionYears.note: No retention period found in the bye-laws or rules text seen; bye-law 142 lists registers to be maintained and bye-law 124 requires records kept at society premises.

memberInspectionRight.value: Member may inspect books/registers/documents free of cost and obtain copies on fee (bye-law 23, s.32(1),(2)). Bill 154B-8: free inspection during office hours of bye-laws, records, books of accounts, correspondence excluding other members' personal information; copies within one month of fee.
memberInspectionRight.note: Bye-law 172 sets copy fees; Chapter 154B enacted wording not verified
memberInspectionRight.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 23; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified)

authority.value: State Co-operative Election Authority (SCEA) has superintendence, direction and control of electoral rolls and elections (s.73CB(1), inserted by 2013 amendment replacing Chapter XIA). Societies with 200+ members (Type C): Taluka/Ward Co-operative Election Officer appoints Returning Officer from Co-operation Department; society informs 180 days before term expiry. Societies with fewer than 200 members at 31 March (Type D): election at a SGM presided by person appointed by SCEA, notice at least 15 days by Presiding Officer; presiding officer has no vote; fallback to Rule 75 process. 2018 proviso to s.73CB(11): housing societies up to 200 members conduct own elections 'in the manner prescribed' - prescription not found.
authority.note: Cutoff discrepancy: 'less than 200' (Rule 4(IV)) vs 'up to 200' (2018 proviso). A 2019 bill proposing 250 not verified.
authority.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) rules 4, 75, 76; https://indiancooperative.com/?p=9646; Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified)

societyRunProcessSecondary.value: Model election regulations (Annexure III, not in the copy seen), per secondary: Committee prepares provisional voter list 60 days before election, 8 days for objections, final list within 2 days, appoints Returning Officer from non-candidates who undertake not to contest/propose/second; RO declares programme within 7 days.
societyRunProcessSecondary.note: Likely superseded for most societies by the 2014 Election Rules

timelineTypeC.value: Programme days: provisional list day 1; claims 5 days; decision within 2 days; final list; nominations close 5 days after final list; scrutiny next day; valid list next day; withdrawal 15 days after valid list; poll min 5 days after withdrawal; count and result immediately. Rejected nomination: appeal to Registrar within 3 days, disposed within 10 days. Office-bearers chosen within 10 days (Type C) / 15 days (Type D). Disputes: election petition to Co-operative Court (s.91, rule 78).
timelineTypeC.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) rules 75, 76, 77, 78

casualVacancy.value: Committee fills by co-option after 7 days' notice-board call for nominations; term coterminous (Rule 106C-13(4), 2026). Model bye-law 129: co-option not more than two.
casualVacancy.source: Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Gazette notification 18 Jun 2026), new Rule 106C-13(3), as reproduced at https://taxguru.in/corporate-law/maharashtra-co-operative-societies-amendment-rules-2026.html (secondary reproduction; gazette PDF not seen); 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-law 129

reservations.value: Model bye-law 115 (citing s.73BBB): committee 5/7/9/11 including reserved women seats (secondary table: up to 50 members 4+1; 51-100 6+1; 101-300 8+1; 301+ 9+2); if women unavailable, seats filled by others. Election Rules r.2(15): reserved seats for SC/ST, Women, De-notified/Nomadic Tribes, Special Backward Classes, OBC. Bill 70/2018 proposed s.154B-20/21: 3 reserved seats (SC/ST 1, OBC 1, VJ/NT/SBC 1) plus 2 women; unfilled reserved seats not counted for quorum. CONFLICT between 1 and 2 women seats.
reservations.source: https://blog.ipleaders.in/election-procedure-for-housing-societies/ (secondary); Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Election to Committee) Rules, 2014 (notification 11 Sep 2014), copy at https://consumerresourcesin.files.wordpress.com/2014/10/election_rules_final.pdf (third-party host of Gazette text) rule 2(15); Maharashtra Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill No. 70 of 2018 (housing chapter, proposed ss.154B-1 onward), https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_states/maharashtra/2018/Bill%20no%2070%20of%202018%20MH.pdf (BILL text; final enacted wording not verified)

termYears.note: Committee elected for 5 years (bye-laws 116(a), 122); office-bearers 5 years but not beyond committee term (bye-law 126). Bill 154B-19(3): five years from first meeting of newly constituted committee. 2018 amendment to s.73AAA(3): members deemed to have vacated on expiry of term (amending-act text read).
termYears.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 116, 122, 126; https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/acts_states/maharashtra/1961/1961MH24.pdf

eligibility.value: Not eligible if: conviction for moral turpitude within 6 years; default of dues within 3 months of written notice; held responsible under ss.79/88/85; sublet/leased flat without permission or sold shares; associate member without NOC/undertaking; otherwise ineligible under Act/Rules (bye-law 118). Ceases to be member after missing 3 consecutive monthly meetings without leave (bye-law 120).
eligibility.source: 2014 Model Bye-laws of Co-operative Housing Societies (Maharashtra), copy at https://adda.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/maharashtra-co-operative-housing-society-bye-laws.pdf (third-party host of the official text; official sahakarayukta.maharashtra.gov.in PDF URLs returned a server error) bye-laws 118, 120

defaulterDisqualification.value: Bye-law 118(ii): member who has not paid dues within three months from service of written notice (by hand or post under certificate of posting) is ineligible for election/co-option. Secondary: nomination invalid if dues unpaid at nomination and scrutiny; arrears beyond 90 days at scrutiny ineligible, but proposer/seconder may be in arrears. Bill 154B-23: 'defaulter' disqualifies; 5-year bar after certain disqualifications.

Rule 106C-13(1)(b)-(c): Registrar to issue NEW model bye-laws; societies may adopt within 3 months of publication. Bye-law numbers cited are the 2014 model; the society's own registered bye-laws control until changed.
Bye-law numbering differs across published copies (quorum cited as bye-law 100 in some secondary sources, 101 in the copy read).

Part IXB (Arts 243ZI-ZT, 97th Amendment) was held operative only for multi-State societies (Rajendra Shah, 2021, para 77, read); Maharashtra's SCEA/election regime rests on the State statute (2013 amendments), not Part IXB.
